en: Black‑and‑white image of a broad, tree‑lined avenue in a park or landscaped promenade. Tall deciduous trees on both sides form an arch overhead, with simple metal railings and low posts along the paths. The road forks into two directions in the distance. A child stands on the left beside the railing, while a woman in a long dress and hat walks on the right, suggesting late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century fashion. The background shows faint outlines of large buildings behind the trees.
